resources.string: High boost levels can distort sound and stress speakers. Increase gradually.
Keeps volume boost active in the background
Choose classic controls, media seek bar, both, or neither. While boost is on, Android still shows a minimal ongoing notice if both are off.
Boost reaches every media app, including YouTube and Spotify.
Android hides other apps\' audio sessions, so right now only players that announce theirs (e.g. VLC) are boosted. To boost every app (YouTube, Spotify, browser…) without root, allow audio detection.
Boost reaches every app that is playing, including YouTube and Spotify. The playing app is found by measuring Android\'s audio sessions: the microphone is never used.
Permission denied. You can allow it in the app settings, under Permissions → Microphone.

Without root, Android lets VolumeBoost find the app that is playing (YouTube, Spotify, browser…) only through the "record audio" permission.

It is used only to measure the level of the audio being played. The microphone is never turned on, and nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.

When Android asks, choose "While using the app": with "Only this time" detection stops once the app is closed.
